title: Motor neuron → muscle → FlyBody actuator map
note: Connectome circuits can be attached to the physical body only where a motor neuron's muscle target is known. Coverage is incomplete. Cross-sex FANC muscle targets transferred onto MaleCNS/MANC are labeled INFERRED, not measured from the MaleCNS specimen.
references: Azevedo et al. 2024 Nature: female VNC reconstruction; muscle targets for leg and wing motor neurons (EM, genetics, X-ray tomography).
Lesser / MANC motor-neuron annotations: 737 annotated motor neurons plus premotor networks.
Each leg ~60–70 identifiable motor neurons; each wing side ~29.
